Subject: 22f3002716 – System Commands BPT 2 & 4 marks discrepancies

Dear Sir / Madam

With reference to the subject, I would like to bring to your attention a discrepancy observed in the evaluation of BPT2_Problem4 and BPT4_Problem3. Both problems have been awarded zero marks, despite the fact that some public and private test cases were successfully passed (attached the snapshot of synchro eval as well as the BPT scores as per my dashboard.

I kindly request that these submissions be re-evaluated / considered prior to finalizing the overall score. Your consideration and continued support in ensuring a fair assessment are sincerely appreciated.

Thank you for your usual cooperation.

Warm regards,

PS: I tried to write this problem to support, they requested me to post it in discourse.
